title: Multi-omics biomarker discovery in early-stage breast and prostate cancer: analysis scripts
description: R scripts for the paired tumour-versus-normal analysis of TCGA-BRCA and TCGA-PRAD (methylation, RNA and protein), integration with MOFA2 and DIABLO, patient-grouped stability selection and nested resampling, permuted-label and leakage controls, external validation in GEO cohorts, and clinical analyses. The data are not included; they are available from the NCI Genomic Data Commons and the Gene Expression Omnibus.
